format_upgrade.policy: Geographic payload and existing offsets are unchanged. The v19 header selects the authored Dusk table appended by the pinned transformer. The demo recipe pads the result to a 512-byte boundary.

terrain.policy: Existing embedded OBCT3 surface reused byte for byte for contours, ascent and final embedding.

command: target/release/obc-pack PINNED/switzerland.osm.pbf builder/presets/schema.json OUTPUT.obcm --bbox 8.26,46.54,8.37,46.67 --terrain EXISTING-SURFACE.obcd --landmarks LANDMARKS/content.json --peaks PEAKS/peaks.json
embedding: Terrain embedding uses the alignment and header writer from fixtures/build-map-package.sh grimsel-demo.
network: No download during production: the pinned source packages, the Geofabrik extract and the land polygons were all read from the local caches.
